personas.name: Sophie Bennett
personas.headline: How Sophie never misses an MOT again
personas.summary: Sophie tracks charging on phone, reminders on iPad, MOT docs on laptop.

day.title: Charge log
day.text: After an overnight charge Sophie logs kWh on her phone — a habit that beats guessing range on a Monday.

day.title: Reminder check
day.text: iPad reminders at lunch show MOT window thirty days out; the reminder beats the fine, every time.

day.title: MOT docs
day.text: Laptop document pack holds MOT and insurance; she finds the PDF in seconds, not in email search limbo.

day.title: Garage
day.text: Garage on the laptop is one calm overview — EV and reminders in one place.

day.title: Phone
day.text: Phone Today confirms tomorrow’s charge window. She locks the screen without a paperwork spike.

personas.name: Rashid Nasser
personas.goal: Three business cars and their papers
personas.headline: How Rashid keeps a tiny fleet documented
personas.summary: Rashid checks Today on phone, service on iPad at the yard, papers on laptop at the office.

day.title: Yard Today
day.text: At the yard Rashid opens Today on his phone across three business cars — what moves today, what waits.

day.title: Service iPad
day.text: iPad service board on the bench keeps the tiny fleet honest; gaps show up before a customer does.

day.title: Office laptop
day.text: Office laptop holds papers — registration, insurance — so “where is the file?” stops being a weekly sport.

day.title: Fuel costs
day.text: Fuel rollup on the laptop is illustrative; he uses it to see patterns, not to micromanage drivers by the litre.

day.title: Phone close
day.text: Phone confirms tomorrow’s plan. Three cars. Zero missing papers in his head.
